description: Renpass (Renewable Energy Pathways Simulation System) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by ZNES Flensburg. renpass is an open source simulation energy model which has the goal to fulfil the requirements of full transparency and the possibility to image 100% renewable energy systems as well as today's system on a high regional and time resolution. Coverage: Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Finland, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, France, Switzerland, Austria, the Czech Republic, Germany. The fact sheet classes it as: Electricity System Model / Regional Dispatch Model / Transshipment Model. Sectors: Electricity. Resolution: time Hour, geography Germany: 21 regions / other countries: country. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
